name: lerpa-component
description: Discover and install 1,328 Lerpa UI copy-paste registry items (1,109 registry:ui and 219 registry:block) for React 18/19 and Tailwind CSS v4. Items use token-backed styling and may use Framer Motion, Radix UI, Recharts, and Lucide.
when_to_use: User asks to build, scaffold, or extend a React and Tailwind UI
User mentions shadcn, Radix, or copy-paste components and wants pre-built primitives
User wants animated, theme-aware UI with reduced-motion support
User asks for an AI, dashboard, ecommerce, marketing, auth, or documentation surface
when_not_to_use: User wants server-only logic with no UI surface
User requires a component with no third-party dependencies without first checking the selected item

capabilities.label: UI Component
capabilities.description: Single-purpose primitives and composed UI. 1,109 registry items are available.

capabilities.label: Page Block
capabilities.description: Composed sections such as heroes, pricing, footers, CTAs, feature grids, and dashboard areas. 219 registry items are available.

capabilities.label: Dashboard Primitive
capabilities.description: Stats, feeds, KPI cards, tables, and chart containers.

capabilities.label: Animation Primitive
capabilities.description: Framer Motion and CSS animation components with project-specific accessibility review still required.

accessibility: Prefer semantic controls and standard keyboard behavior
Animated components must provide reduced-motion behavior
Verify labels, focus, contrast, keyboard behavior, and screen-reader output in the consuming application

examples.prompt: Build a marketing landing page with a developer hero, pricing comparison, and CTA.
Add a CRM dashboard with revenue, contact profile, and activity feed.
Compose an AI chat surface with token usage and tool-call history.
Build a checkout flow with cart summary, address form, and review step.
